calibration_purpose: Calibrate vehicle dynamics only; no model prediction, reactive label, or benchmark result used for candidate selection. Preserve failed candidates and the original 8 m/s² threshold.
protocol: Spawn at rest; apply exactly one optional physics factor override; 1s settle; old PI tracks the recorded target speed for the recorded cruise duration with recorded cap/rise; brake ramps to recorded cap for up to6s until below .1m/s; hold .5s; resume same PI up to8s. Gear mode is fixed by parameters. No set_transform/set_target_velocity/set_target_angular_velocity calls.
